plan: In a second-price auction, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy regardless of the number of competitors or their behavior. This is because you win whenever your value exceeds the second-highest bid, and you pay that second-highest bid, not your own bid. Bidding above your value risks winning and overpaying (paying more than the item is worth), while bidding below risks losing profitable opportunities. Therefore, I will bid exactly my value of $14 to maximize expected profit.
